cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 96; offset-1 members L95, Falinks offset 2 L96.
chronology_note: Same audit as E0482 (party_vr96_b); two reachable legends (Chi-Yu, Landorus), no window-90 addition used.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Pachirisu Follow Me redirects single-target attacks off Pinsir; Nuzzle paralysis
Naganadel Nasty Plot / Beast Boost after a KO
Lickilicky Cloud Nine and Normal Gem Body Slam
Mega Falinks No Retreat then sweep

attempts.why: Turn 1 Pinsir Protected and Pachirisu Follow Me'd; spread Heat Wave + Rock Slide ignored the redirect and took Pachirisu to 125. Turn 2 the AI switched Pinsir out for Falinks, which was OHKO'd (un-Mega'd, never acted) by the same two spreads alongside Pachirisu. Turn 3 Pinsir Protected again while Lickilicky Stomping Tantrum took Chi-Yu to 62. Turn 4 Lickilicky Protected; Heat Wave OHKO'd Pinsir. Turn 5 Naganadel Draco Meteor OHKO'd Landorus (307 exactly) behind Chi-Yu's Protect; Beast Boost +1 Speed. Turn 6 Mega Kangaskhan Fake Out flinched Naganadel, Overheat KO'd Lickilicky. Turn 7 Sludge Bomb + Close Combat took the incoming Urshifu to 39 and poisoned it; Double-Edge KO'd Naganadel. Turn 8 Zarude Knock Off KO'd Urshifu, Double-Edge KO'd Zarude. Faints: Landorus, Urshifu.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 1 and 2 Follow Me; spread attacks went through it as the crack line says
Pachirisu used Follow Me both turns and died
Pinsir's four turns on the field: Protect, switch out, Protect, X-Scissor chosen but KO'd first; it never landed a hit
turn 5 Draco Meteor OHKO on Landorus, 'Speed rose!'; Nasty Plot never chosen (a KO was available every turn, fair)
turn 7 Close Combat 289-class hit, turn 8 Knock Off KO
Cloud Nine announced on entry; Body Slam chosen turn 5 into Protect and the Gem never fired; Stomping Tantrum did 180 to Chi-Yu
Falinks was switched in on turn 2 into a double spread and fainted without Mega Evolving or acting

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked Heat Wave + Rock Slide (both super effective, lethal) - good
blocked the same lethal pair again - good; partner Lickilicky hit Chi-Yu for 180
blocked Earth Power + Heat Wave (~500) - good, but Pinsir died beside it

protect_summary: 3 Protects, all good; the problem is what happened between them.

ai_defects.board: Pinsir 258/258 (just Protected) + Pachirisu 125/308 vs Chi-Yu 242/242 + Landorus 307/307, both spreading
ai_defects.chosen: Pinsir switched out to Falinks (the Mega closer, slot 6)
ai_defects.better: Attack (X-Scissor/Close Combat into Chi-Yu, or Rock Slide) or Protect again. The switch put the L96 Mega ace into two super-effective/neutral spreads at 4 HP EVs; it fainted without Mega Evolving or using No Retreat. Pinsir then came back in anyway. The ace was thrown away by a switch with no defensive purpose (Falinks resists neither Fire nor Rock).

ai_notes: Follow Me every turn while spread moves were being used was the authored behaviour, not a defect, but the AI did not adapt to spread (Nuzzle on Chi-Yu would have been better on turn 2). Naganadel's Draco Meteor target choice (Landorus over the Protecting Chi-Yu) was right.
level_change_rationale: Won first try but after a real fight with 2 faints (Draco Meteor and a Knock Off KO). Keep. The result was flattered by the AI throwing away Mega Falinks; the fix is the switch logic, not levels.
cooler: The redirection door works as written against single-target play and is punished by spread exactly as the crack says. The memorable piece never appeared: Mega Falinks needs to reach the field late and alive. Consider whether the AI's mid-battle switch should ever bring the last-slot Mega in before slot 5 is gone; that is an AI policy question for the main agent, not a set change.
